title: The Signature Roommate Resource Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Shared-living agreements, chore templates, and conflict-resolution resources. The Roommate Resource Database provides the paperwork of shared living: roommate agreement templates covering rent splits, bills, guests, quiet hours, and cleaning, plus chore-rotation templates and conflict-resolution procedures. Everything is a reusable template, not legal advice. The Signature side adds scenario walkthroughs showing how agreements resolve common disputes.
capabilities: Provide roommate agreement templates with key clauses

Document conflict-resolution procedures step by step
Walk through common dispute scenarios with resolutions
Cover guest, quiet-hour, and shared-space rules
